name: PhotoCraft v0.14.0
body:
> [!NOTE]
> **FreeBSD aarch64 is dropped from this release.** We had to cut releases, and we cannot build this target within the 5-hour CI limit for any of the Craft apps, so we are dropping it for now. This is a known blocker, flagged for a future fix in storytold/craft-common-actions#39. FreeBSD x86_64 and every other platform are included.


## What's Changed
* Automation: tighten workspace checks for export, linked files and dialogs by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8680
* View › Extras (Cmd+H) hides the Move tool's transform controls by @mercuryVM in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6705
* fix(raster): prevent overflow in strided row sampling by @Lucenx9 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8668
* security: index slice IDs in PSD slices parser by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8417
* security: preflight PCX and XPM allocations by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8405
* security: harden native temporary and recovery files by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8406
* security: admit embedded SVG raster images by header size by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8504
* security: stop double decompression of gzip-compressed SVG by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8505

## New Contributors
* @mercuryVM made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6705

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/compare/v0.13.0...v0.14.0
